battlecards.why_selected: Able to migrate to OMNIA Partners contract delivering 16% lower daily rates without changing traveler experience
battlecards.contract_terms: OMNIA Partners master agreement – no participation fees, no blackout dates, local account management; market-share commitment required
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Public-sector GPO pricing significantly below direct corporate agreement; willingness to shift 100% of car rental volume
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Extensive US network, Emerald Aisle service, proven service levels with Arotech travelers
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Some premium classes slightly higher than GPO rates (PFAR, SKAR)
battlecards.switching_costs: Minimal – same supplier, only rate code change in Egencia
battlecards.notes: Two revised documents sent via DocuSign 12/8/22 must be executed for rates to load.

battlecards.why_selected: 10% global discount across 17 IHG brands with no room-night commitment; easy integration with Egencia
battlecards.contract_terms: Business Edge enrollment – annual program, no fixed term, discount auto-renews with continued membership
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Aggregated spend commitment (targeting 50% of unmanaged hotel spend) provided leverage to access tiered discount
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Large global footprint, consistent mid-scale brands matching travel patterns, loyalty benefits for travelers
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Requires travelers to shift stays from Marriott/Hilton properties
battlecards.switching_costs: Traveler habit change and policy enforcement
battlecards.notes: Rates already loaded into Egencia; announcement memo pending circulation.

battlecards.supplier_name: Holiday Inn Express & Suites – Ann Arbor (IHG)
battlecards.why_selected: Offered $105 flat rate (17% below current average) plus complimentary breakfast & parking
battlecards.contract_terms: Fixed rate through 12/31/2023; Non-last-room-availability; quarterly performance reviews
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Estimated 126 annual nights; competitive landscape in Ann Arbor
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Newer property, included amenities valued by travelers
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Rate subject to availability; 24-hr cancellation policy
battlecards.switching_costs: Minimal – same city, booking through Egencia

battlecards.supplier_name: Courtyard by Marriott Mesa at Wrigleyville West
battlecards.why_selected: Agreed to $188 rate vs $221 historical average for 126 annual nights
battlecards.contract_terms: 2023 preferred rate, standard Marriott cancellation (48 hrs)
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Consolidated volume commitment for Mesa/Phoenix market
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Close to client site, Marriott Bonvoy benefits
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Higher base rate than limited-service options
battlecards.switching_costs: Traveler familiarity and loyalty program changes

battlecards.supplier_name: Courtyard by Marriott Orlando International Drive
battlecards.why_selected: Offered $110 rate vs $129 historical average for regular Orlando travel
battlecards.contract_terms: Preferred corporate rate valid CY2023, 24-hr cancellation
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Regular 54 night annual volume presented to hotel
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Location near convention center, consistent brand standards
battlecards.switching_costs: Low – same chain as many existing stays

battlecards.why_selected: Provided contract pricing averaging 5% below Amazon on high-usage IT SKUs; ability to extend credit terms and reporting
battlecards.contract_terms: Master reseller agreement; no minimums; pricing reviewed annually
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Competitive quote exercise using detailed Amazon purchase history for $438K of spend
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Dedicated account team, punch-out catalog, broad distributor network
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Longer lead times on low-volume niche items vs Amazon Prime
battlecards.switching_costs: Onboarding users to new portal, updating PO workflows
battlecards.notes: Savings assumed on 50% of Amazon hardware spend; further migration could increase savings.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Higher average unit pricing; limited ability to lock contract rates or provide reporting
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Threat of migration to contracted reseller with fixed discounts
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Ease of ordering, fast shipping, broad catalog
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Dynamic pricing, limited strategic support, no fixed discounts
battlecards.switching_costs: Loss of Prime shipping benefits; need to route purchases through PO process
battlecards.notes: Amazon retained for non-addressable miscellaneous purchases outside hardware scope.

battlecards.why_selected: Maintains wide catalog and existing logistics; competitive on many segments after benchmarking
battlecards.contract_terms: Existing agreement retained; no volume commitment; to be supplemented by Fastenal for select SKUs
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Threat of diverting categories with >20% price gaps to Fastenal
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Established account set-up, integrated e-procurement, broad inventory
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Higher pricing in Plumbing, Adhesives, Material Handling
battlecards.switching_costs: Systems integrations, user familiarity, national branch network
battlecards.notes: Continues to capture majority of MRO spend; targeted categories moved to Fastenal.

battlecards.why_selected: Provided 18-50% lower pricing on targeted sub-categories (e.g., Plumbing 50%, Adhesives 34%) with no volume commitment
battlecards.contract_terms: OMNIA participation agreement – no minimum spend, access to national price file
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Ability to shift spend away from Grainger quickly
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Competitive pricing, local branch support, vending solutions
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Narrower catalog than Grainger, potential freight on low-value orders
battlecards.switching_costs: Set-up of new vendor accounts and part number cross-referencing
battlecards.notes: Savings captured when Arotech routes high-gap categories to Fastenal.
